sentences.text: Mr. Shreekant Dubey, learned counsel for the applicant.
Mr. G.S. Thakur, learned Panel Lawyer for the State.
Heard on I.A. No.8788/17 an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Call for the records of the trial Court as well as the appellate Court.
The applicant has been convicted for an offence U/s.7(1) R/w. Section 16(1)(A)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for six month.

Looking to the short sentence of six months, I am inclined to allow I.A. No.8788/17 and suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of the applicant herein subject to his depositing the amount of fine and direct that the applicant herein shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with a surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
The applicant shall appear before the Registry of this Court on 21.12.2017 and on such other dates as may be directed in this behalf.

(ATUL SREEDHARAN) JUDGE a Manish Kumar Soni vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84755007/
